items.title: How Amazon CloudFront helped deliver Grand Theft Auto VI to players
items.summary: Some launches are big. After 13 years of anticipation, Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) was one of the biggest ever, and Amazon CloudFront helped deliver it. When the game unlocked at midnight on November 19, 2026, in Auckland, New Zealand, it ended one of the longest waits in gaming. Over the next 18 hours, […]
